text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Welcoming summer training camp, KS Miracle 
kept her feet firmly on the ground while 
doing her absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day—called out because she had 
something to say, the Trainer was told by 
her that she wanted to become the "fastest 
of her era."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she competed with her rivals, K.S. 
Miracle began yearning for more than just 
repaying her debts. With a new goal in her 
heart, she advances to the Sprinters 
Stakes.
